title: Every Embassy in the World
excerpt: 15,584 embassies, consulates and missions on one map. Washington hosts 181 embassies, the Holy See runs 88 nunciatures, and the resident embassy turns out to be a Renaissance invention.
seo_description: The world's 15,584 embassies and consulates mapped from open data, every country's network, and diplomacy from Amarna to today.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Every Embassy in the World' in black and red on pale paper, beside a world map with gold lines from Rome to the Holy See's nunciatures and small red dots for embassies. Text: 15,584 missions mapped; Washington, D.C.: 181 embassies.
